title: Is It Good to Buy a Flat in Bangalore? Prices, Rent vs EMI and Who Should Buy (2026)
seoTitle: Is It Good to Buy a Flat in Bangalore? 2026 Rent vs EMI
seoDescription: Bangalore flats average about ₹9,600/sq ft in 2026. Compare EMI vs rent on a ₹1 crore 2BHK, stamp duty, loan rules and the best areas before you buy.
excerpt: Weighs buying against renting with typical EMI and 2BHK rent ranges, highlights areas such as Whitefield, Sarjapur Road and Hebbal, and suggests buying mainly if you plan to stay 8 to 10 years or more.
